value.rationale: The entire Walsh spectrum of the canonical order-five derangement incidence orbit is a natural finite harmonic invariant. Its exact norm, nontrivial kernel size and sharp positive spectral gap answer specific questions of Fourier projection amplification and recoverability not determined by counting the 44 derangements or their degree-one covariance. Five is an independently motivated first rich nontrivial odd cutoff, providing a mathematically instructive contrast to the existing order-five unrestricted permutation spectrum. This is a complete exact finite classification rather than an arbitrary unmotivated slice; no unproved downstream consequences are claimed.
